bad.title: An info button that does nothing
bad.text: The tip waits for a hover that a phone never sends.

bad.title: £31 with no reason given
bad.text: People see £7 more than Standard and can’t learn what it buys, so they skip it.

bad.title: Each tap gets the same nothing
bad.text: The taps add up, and the answer never appears.
bad.wait: Tap the info button to see this.

good.title: Tap opens it, tap again closes
good.text: Works the same with a finger, a mouse or the Enter key.

good.title: £31 now has a reason
good.text: With the fee explained, the £7 over Standard reads as a choice, not a surprise.

good.title: The extra fee explained in one line
good.text: Free date changes up to a day before travel. People can judge if it’s worth it.
good.wait: Tap the info button to see this.

bad.title: The warning hides behind this icon
bad.text: Most people never point at it, so they change the setting without reading it.

bad.title: Nothing near the choice warns
bad.text: After 24 hours looks like it only affects new messages.

bad.title: Two messages gone for everyone
bad.text: Mum’s and Sam’s messages vanish for all 4 people, and Off won’t bring them back.
bad.wait: Set Disappearing messages to After 24 hours to see this.

good.title: The warning sits under the choice
good.text: People read it on the way to the dropdown, before anything is deleted.

good.title: Same choice, now made knowingly
good.text: After 24 hours still deletes old messages, but people pick it with the facts in view.

bad.title: Hover is the only way in
bad.text: The tip shows on hover or focus and closes the moment either moves on.

bad.title: Learn more only looks like a link
bad.text: It’s plain text in a tooltip, so neither a click nor Tab can reach it.
bad.wait: Point at the info icon to see this.

good.title: A click opens it, and it stays
good.text: The popover waits until people click again, press Esc or click elsewhere.

good.title: Learn more is a real button
good.text: People can click it or Tab to it, and it opens the help page.
good.wait: Click the info icon to see this.

bad.title: The label already says it all
bad.text: Add to cart with a plus icon needs no extra words.

bad.title: The tip repeats the same three words
bad.text: It pops up over the card next to £39.00 and tells people nothing new.
bad.wait: Point at Add to cart to see this.

bad.title: Screen readers say it twice
bad.text: People who listen hear “Add to cart” two times on every visit.
bad.wait: Point at Add to cart to see this.

good.title: The label does the job alone
good.text: Nothing pops up, so the price and photo stay clear while people point.

good.title: Heard once, then done
good.text: People who listen hear the label and the role, nothing repeated.
good.wait: Point at Add to cart to see this.

bad.title: Seven fields in a 150px box
bad.text: Only two or three fit at once, so people scroll inside it to find Place.
bad.wait: Click Team lunch to see this.

bad.title: Place sits below the fold
bad.text: The one field the task needs is hidden until people scroll the box.
bad.wait: Click Team lunch, then scroll the box, to see this.

good.title: A side panel with room for all
good.text: All seven fields show at once, beside the day, with no scrolling.
good.wait: Click Team lunch to see this.

good.title: Grouped under When, Where and Who
good.text: People jump to Where for the place without reading every label.
good.wait: Click Team lunch to see this.

good.title: Save stays in view
good.text: The footer doesn’t scroll, so people finish without hunting for it.
good.wait: Click Team lunch to see this.

bad.title: The name counts only after Apply
bad.text: Typing alone changes nothing, so the new name lives only in the box.

bad.title: A stray click drops the name
bad.text: Click outside, and the file is still Budget 2026. The typed name is gone.
bad.wait: Press Rename, type a name, then click outside to see this.

good.title: Saved as people type
good.text: Each letter applies to the file at once, so there’s no step left to forget.

good.title: The new name survives the click
good.text: Click outside, press Esc or Enter. The file keeps the name typed.
good.wait: Press Rename, type a name, then click outside to see this.

bad.title: Every pick sends people back here
bad.text: Choosing Orange closes all the layers, so Large starts again from Text style.

bad.title: Orange sits three layers deep
bad.text: People open Text style, Color and More colors before they can pick it.
bad.wait: Open Text style, Color, then More colors to see this.

bad.title: The click count keeps climbing
bad.text: An orange, large title takes 7 clicks across four popovers.

good.title: Every color in one row
good.text: Orange is one click, with no More colors layer to open.
good.wait: Press Text style to see this.

good.title: Size sits right below
good.text: S, M and L are plain buttons, and the popover stays open after each pick.
good.wait: Press Text style to see this.

good.title: Done in 3 clicks
good.text: Text style, Orange, then L. Under half the clicks of the nested menus.

bad.title: The slider sits on the photo
bad.text: It covers the hills and sky that people are trying to brighten.

bad.title: Only the edges show the change
bad.text: People drag, press Done to look, then open Brightness again to adjust.

good.title: Slider beside, photo uncovered
good.text: Dragging from 70% shows the effect live on the whole picture.

good.title: Every drag shows on the photo
good.text: People stop when it looks right, with no closing and reopening.

bad.title: Twenty items, no groups
bad.text: Nothing to skip, so people read every item from Open down.
bad.wait: Open the ⋯ menu to see this.

bad.title: Copy link sits 16th
bad.text: It starts out of view, so people scroll past it or give up first.
bad.wait: Open the ⋯ menu and scroll to see this.

good.title: Copy link is second, near the top
good.text: Sharing actions come first, so it’s found at a glance.
good.wait: Open the ⋯ menu to see this.

good.title: Move to trash on its own
good.text: A divider sets it apart from Rename and Move to…, so it’s hard to hit by mistake.
good.wait: Open the ⋯ menu to see this.

good.title: Search reaches the other 13
good.text: Type “col” and Change color… appears, though it isn’t in the short list.
good.wait: Open the ⋯ menu to see this.

bad.title: Reply hides behind ⋯
bad.text: Nothing on screen says Reply, so people open the menu to look for it.

bad.title: Reply is fifth of seven
bad.text: People read past Mark as unread, Snooze, Move to… and Add label every time.
bad.wait: Open the ⋯ menu to see this.

good.title: Reply is one click away
good.text: The action people take most sits in the bar, so answering Lena takes 1 click.

good.title: ⋯ keeps the six rare ones
good.text: Forward, Snooze and Print still have a home, out of the way.

bad.title: Only Standard shows
bad.text: The other three options stay hidden until people open the menu.

bad.title: One price and date at a time
bad.text: People must remember Free and Thu 29 Oct while they go and check Express.

bad.title: Names only, no prices
bad.text: Nothing in the list says which option is cheap or which is fast.
bad.wait: Open the Delivery menu to see this.

good.title: All four options in one look
good.text: Price and date sit on every row, so people compare without opening anything.

good.title: Free and ready by Wednesday
good.text: Pick up in store answers the task at a glance: no cost, ready Wed 28 Oct.

bad.title: Download opens a second menu
bad.text: Whole document or Selected text comes next, then a third menu for the format.

bad.title: Word is three levels deep
bad.text: A slip onto Selected text on the way swaps the menu, and the wrong part downloads.
bad.wait: Open File, Download, then Whole document to see this.

good.title: Download… promises a dialog
good.text: The … says more choices follow in one place, not another menu to steer through.

good.title: Every format, with what it’s for
good.text: PDF for sharing, Word for editing, Plain text for words only.
good.wait: Open File, then Download…, to see this.

good.title: Whole or selected, side by side
good.text: Nothing switches on hover, so a slip of the pointer can’t change the choice.
good.wait: Open File, then Download…, to see this.
